_comment: industry key -> the Config Doc in config/ that ships bundled for it. build/build.js reads these files and generates the DEMO_CONFIG object into the <!--mom:demo-configs--> slot in src/shell.html. The CSV on disk is the only copy: there is no literal to keep in step, because the one the browser loads does not exist until the build runs. Adding an industry means adding a CSV and a line here.
